title: Run W-3: Ti-doped FeGaSe
subtitle: Standard budget: 20 measurements, 21 days · delivered B005 · passed
task: Dope FeGaSe with Ti. Above a critical Ti content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry, and the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 123.6 ± 3.0 K. Budget: 20 measurements (XRD, M(T), EDX) and 21 simulated days; every sample is made step by step on the bench.

outcome.headline: Delivered B005: distorted, single phase, ordering temperature 123.9 K against a 123.6 ± 3 K target.

items.name: Distorted phase
items.note: Ti on the metal site 0.434 (weighed-in 0.459); distorted structure

steps.obs:
Dope FeGaSe with Ti. Above a critical Ti content the structure distorts to a lower symmetry; the device needs that distorted phase. Deliver a single-phase sample of the distorted phase whose magnetic ordering temperature is 123.6 +/- 3.0 K.
Lab rules and conventions:
- There is no one-step synthesis. Make every sample on the bench: take vessels (jar, boat, ampoule, vial,
  crucible), weigh element powders, grind, press, load and seal ampoules, heat in a furnace, collect the product.
-…

steps.say: Weighed two compositions (Ti x=0.3 and x=0.5); now grinding, sealing in Ar ampoules and heating.

events: B001 formed: Ti on the metal site 0.288 (weighed-in 0.301, 0.013 lost to evaporation); undistorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 126.4 K; the charge saw 780 °C (set 780 °C)
B002 formed: Ti on the metal site 0.471 (weighed-in 0.500, 0.028 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 130.6 K; the charge saw 840 °C (set 840 °C)

steps.say: Both samples made and measured; reading XRD and M(T) data now.

steps.obs: instrument.instprm: 16 lines, from line 0: #GSAS-II instrument parameter file; do not add/delete items! | Type:PXC | Bank:1.0 | Lam1:1.540560 | Lam2:1.544390 | Zero:0.0000 | …

steps.say: B001 (x=0.3) is tetragonal with T_C≈126 K; B002 (x=0.5) shows split peaks (distorted) with T_C≈130 K. Mapping more compositions next.

events: B003 formed: Ti on the metal site 0.380 (weighed-in 0.400, 0.020 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 114.2 K; the charge saw 810 °C (set 810 °C)
B004 formed: Ti on the metal site 0.426 (weighed-in 0.450, 0.024 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 122.5 K; the charge saw 825 °C (set 825 °C)

steps.say: Collected x=0.40 (B003) and x=0.45 (B004); measuring them.
B003 (x=0.40) is still tetragonal (T_C≈113 K); B004 (x=0.45) is distorted with T_C≈122 K, and the distorted-phase T_C rises ~160 K per unit x. Making x=0.46 to hit 123.6 K centrally.

events: B005 formed: Ti on the metal site 0.434 (weighed-in 0.459, 0.025 lost to evaporation); distorted structure; single phase; true ordering temperature 123.9 K; the charge saw 830 °C (set 830 °C)

steps.say: x=0.46 sample (B005) measured; checking its T_C and XRD.
